# Frequently Asked Questions

Here are answers to the most common questions our clients ask before starting their projects.

*Clear Answers.*
*Strong Relationships.*

## General Questions

**01**
**What services do you offer?**
I offer complete web solutions including website design, development, eCommerce, maintenance, SEO, domain, hosting and email setup.

**02**
**How long does it take to complete a website?**
It depends on the project. A basic website takes 5-7 days, while complex websites or eCommerce stores may take 10-20 days.

**03**
**What are your payment terms?**
I take 50% advance to start the project and 50% after completion before final delivery.

**04**
**Will my website be mobile responsive?**
Yes, all websites I design are 100% responsive and work perfectly on all devices.

**05**
**Can I update my website content myself?**
Yes, I build websites with user-friendly dashboards so you can easily update content, images, and pages.

**06**
**Do you use templates or custom design?**
I create 100% custom designs tailored to your business needs. No copy-paste templates.

**07**
**Will my website be SEO friendly?**
Yes, all websites are built with SEO best practices to help you rank better on search engines.

**08**
**Do you provide domain and hosting?**
Yes, I can help you buy the best domain and hosting and handle the complete setup for you.

**09**
**Do you provide support after website delivery?**
Yes, I provide free support for a limited period and paid support plans are also available.

**10**
**Can you redesign my old website?**
Yes, I can redesign your website with a modern look, better performance and improved user experience.
